title: Rewiring of Powerhouse building, Inspection Quarter and Provision of Garden and compound Lights at Kilakkarai Lighthouse under Chennai Directorate
summary: E-tender (two-cover) for rewiring of the powerhouse building and inspection quarter and provision of garden and compound lights at Kilakkarai Lighthouse, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Kilakkarai Lighthouse
sites.work: Rewiring of powerhouse building and inspection quarter; provision of garden and compound lights

scope.item: Rewiring of Powerhouse building, Inspection Quarter and Provision of Garden and compound Lights

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any nationalised bank in favour of The Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai; EMD valid 90 days from technical bid opening; EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate. Sale of physical tender document not applicable.

eligibility: Original Equipment Manufacturers or their authorised agents, or appropriate class contractors registered with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, BSNL etc. or any other State/Central Government/PSU/autonomous body
Experience in electrification, rewiring of buildings and UG cable works
notes: Document is Section 1 (NIT) only, printed page numbers 3-4; no BOQ or detailed scope included. Bid submission 12/03/2026 1800 hrs to 02/04/2026 1600 hrs; technical bid opening 03/04/2026 1630 hrs; EMD submission 12/03/2026 0900 hrs to 02/04/2026 1600 hrs.
